instruction: Turn off Safe Browsing protection in Chrome's security settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled Do Not Track in Chrome by navigating Settings > Privacy and Security > Third-party cookies, toggling the DNT option, and confirming the dialog. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome menu, navigate to Settings, find specific settings sections, toggle switches, and confirm dialog prompts.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the same Privacy and Security settings navigation but targets a different sub-section (Security > Safe Browsing). Requires disabling instead of enabling, and involves selecting 'No protection' from the Safe Browsing options with a confirmation dialog.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome Security settings and disabling Safe Browsing protection. Evaluator uses official enable_safe_browsing getter and exact_match metric to verify Safe Browsing is turned off.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter get_enable_safe_browsing correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and checks both safebrowsing.enhanced and safebrowsing.enabled flags, returning 'false' when Safe Browsing is disabled.
Metric exact_match correctly compares getter result 'false' against expected value 'false' for the disabled state.
Postconfig properly kills Chrome and restarts it to flush preferences to disk before the getter reads the Preferences file.
Full coverage: the single instruction requirement (turn off Safe Browsing) is completely verified by the evaluator.
Expected value 'false' is semantically correct for the disabled Safe Browsing state.
